title: Sri Lanka Odyssey: Kandy, Nuwara Eliya and Bentota in Eight Days
alt: Tea pickers at work on the slopes above Nuwara Eliya
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class hotel with views over the Kandy valley

activities.name: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
activities.description: A stop on the way up from the airport to watch the resident herd bathe in the Maha Oya river and feed at the sanctuary.

activities.name: Upper lake drive and Kandyan dance performance
activities.description: An evening circuit of the upper lake road, then the drummers, masked dancers and fire walkers.

activities.name: Kandy sightseeing and a tea plantation
activities.description: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, the Peradeniya gardens and a tea plantation and factory above the town.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: Two nights above the Kandy valley with the elephants on the way in, the upper lake drive and dance show, and a day of the city and a tea estate.

stops.name: Nuwara Eliya
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Standard class hill country hotel close to Gregory Lake

activities.name: Tea plantation on the way to Nuwara Eliya
activities.description: A stop among the terraces for a factory tour and a tasting on the climb into the hills.

activities.name: Nuwara Eliya sightseeing tour
activities.description: Ramboda Falls, a working tea estate and factory, Gregory Lake, Victoria Park, Hakgala gardens and the Seetha Amman temple.

program.name: Nuwara Eliya
program.description: Two unhurried nights in the tea country with the estates on the way up and a full day of the town, its lake, gardens and waterfalls.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Beachfront hotel on the Bentota strip

activities.name: Evening on the Madu River
activities.description: A late afternoon boat through the mangroves as the birds come home to roost.

activities.name: Bentota sightseeing, cinnamon plantation and fish spa
activities.description: The turtle hatchery, a cinnamon plantation, the fish pedicure centre and the beach.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: Two nights on the beach with an evening on the Madu river and a day of Bentota, the cinnamon plantation and the fish spa.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Modern city hotel in the Colombo Fort district

activities.name: Colombo sightseeing and Pettah
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the Fort district and the market lanes of Pettah.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A final night in the Fort district with the sights of the capital and the Pettah bazaars.

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Kandy, the hills and then the coast. Sri Lanka works best when you let the island cool you down before it warms you up again.
expert.tip: Carry a light sweater for Nuwara Eliya. It sits at nearly 1,900 metres and evenings are surprisingly chilly even in April.

summary: Eight days at an easy pace: two nights each in Kandy, the tea country and on the beach at Bentota, with the elephants, the dance show, a tea estate, the Madu River and the cinnamon plantation along the way, then a last night in Colombo.
included: Included: 7 nights in deluxe class hotels with breakfast daily (lunch or dinner also included in Nuwara Eliya); private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary; the upper lake drive and Kandyan dance performance; Kandy sightseeing and a tea plantation; Nuwara Eliya sightseeing; an evening on the Madu River; Bentota sightseeing with the cinnamon plantation and fish spa; Colombo sightseeing and Pettah.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
